text: 自然资源部会同国家发展改革委今天发布《矿产资源目录》，进一步明确了我国矿产种类数量，将成为我国矿产资源规划的基础依据。此次发布的《矿产资源目录》在原《矿产资源分类细目》的基础上进行了优化调整，按能源矿产、金属矿产、非金属矿产和水气矿产4类，对我国矿产资源作出划分，明确了我国现存共174个矿种、119个亚矿种。
text_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources, together with the National Development and Reform Commission, today released the Mineral Resources Catalog, further clarifying the number of mineral types in China, which will become the foundational basis for China's mineral resource planning. The Mineral Resources Catalog released this time was optimized and adjusted based on the original Detailed Classification of Mineral Resources, dividing China's mineral resources into 4 categories: energy minerals, metal minerals, non-metallic minerals, and water and gas minerals, and clarifying that China currently has a total of 174 mineral species and 119 sub-species.
